summary: stui, the phone app and the web app show a seat being replaced by a declaration change as restarting

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; client display only.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. The shared stui contract fixture gains the `restarting` word; no daemon contract changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Display only. Against a daemon that never sends `restarting` these apps behave as before. Builds without this change read the unknown state word as a row labelled not managed (stui, phone) or by its raw word (web), never a decode failure. The web resource family also accepts any state word.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
